provenance.what_still_needs_fleet_hardware: A quiet machine with a live RAPL domain (or a whole-board rail) for CPU joules; an NVIDIA GPU with libnvidia-ml.so.1 for GPU joules; an Apple silicon host with macmon on PATH for the SoC counter. None of those counters were a substitute for the others, and none of them is a Z1 device. BMI fleet hardware is what would meter a sustained run and, separately, any future silicon.
